name: Selldone
description_en:
Selldone is a hosted Business OS combining a storefront with product, order, payment, logistics, marketing and customer operations. Its current homepage emphasizes connecting an AI operator through MCP, with shop-scoped revocable access and approval controls for sensitive changes.

The homepage’s dashboard is an illustrative preview, not a live merchant result. This profile uses browser-rendered official pages because the public HTML reader returned only a JavaScript shell. The pricing page distinguishes a free subscription from transaction charges, and higher tiers raise limits and add selected advanced modules.
description_zh:
Selldone 是托管 Business OS，结合店面、商品、订单、支付、物流、营销及客户运营。当前主页强调通过 MCP 连接 AI 操作员，访问按店铺限定、可撤销，敏感变更设有审批控制。

主页后台是示意预览，不是真实商家结果。因普通网页读取只返回 JavaScript 外壳，本文使用浏览器渲染的官方页面。定价页区分免费订阅与交易收费，高阶套餐提高额度并增加部分高级模块。

sections.title_en: Keep AI preparation separate from approved changes
sections.title_zh: 区分 AI 准备与批准变更
sections.en: An illustrative task is to prepare a collection, inventory update and landing page for review. The homepage describes context reading, preparation and confirmation for sensitive changes. Decide the AI’s exact shop permissions, then inspect proposed products and stock before publishing. No agent was connected and no commerce state was changed in this research; a preview does not demonstrate that every action is safely bounded.
sections.zh: 可设计准备商品系列、库存更新和落地页供审阅的任务。主页描述读取背景、准备及敏感变更确认。应确定 AI 的具体店铺权限，再于发布前检查商品和库存提案。本文未连接 Agent 或修改电商状态，示意预览不能证明所有动作都已安全限定。

sections.title_en: Free subscription still has a platform sales fee
sections.title_zh: 免费订阅仍有平台销售费
sections.en: The rendered price page lists Personal at a free subscription with 2% sales fee, Startup 1.5%, Company 1% and Enterprise 0.5%. It explicitly separates gateway processing fees and says payments settle to the merchant gateway account. File Selling Fee is a distinct row with 30%, 20%, 7% and 3% across those tiers, so a digital-download business must not budget using only the generic sales rate. The selected browser currency was SGD and yearly billing; no universal USD amount is inferred.
sections.zh: 渲染定价页列出 Personal 免费订阅但收 2% 销售费，Startup 1.5%、Company 1%、Enterprise 0.5%，并明确支付网关处理费另计，款项结算至商家网关账户。File Selling Fee 独立列出四档为 30%、20%、7%、3%，数字下载业务不能只按通用销售费率预算。浏览器所选为 SGD 和年付，本文不推断统一美元金额。

sections.title_en: Read limits and module exceptions behind all-features language
sections.title_zh: 核对全功能宣传背后的额度及模块例外
sections.en: The page lists unlimited products but different administrator, domain, storage and campaign limits. Marketplace builder and dropshipping-supplier tools are identified as Enterprise features, and some automation is marked beta. Cards and detailed rows disagree on a few storage values; confirm the applicable allowance in the order rather than choosing the more generous value. A row also labels Magic AI Buttons as requiring a premium subscription despite broad no-upsell wording.
sections.zh: 页面列商品不限量，但管理员、域名、存储和活动额度不同；市场构建和代发供应商工具属于 Enterprise，部分自动化标为 beta。卡片及细表的部分存储值不一致，应确认实际额度，不能挑较宽松值。Magic AI Buttons 还标为需额外 premium 订阅，与宽泛无加购宣传存在范围差异。

sections.title_en: Evaluate a managed store and its gateway eligibility
sections.title_zh: 评估托管店铺及支付准入
sections.en: Merchants wanting one managed operations environment have a relevant case. A business demanding an unrestricted self-hosted backend should confirm licensing first; none was verified. Start with product types, permitted gateway account, shipping rules and staff roles, then test refunds and exported data. The rendered page included a partial 403 notification; no retry or bypass was attempted. Checkout, AI performance and recovery remain untested.
sections.zh: 希望统一托管运营环境的商家有相关场景。要求无限制自托管后端的业务应先确认许可，本文未核实。可从商品类型、可用网关账户、配送规则和员工角色开始，再测试退款及导出。渲染页面出现局部 403 通知，未重试或绕过。本文未测试结账、AI 表现和恢复。
